main_measure.name: OLS slope of coin-demeaned non-overlapping 7-bar forward return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and timing gain > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: book mean daily gain before costs minus gain from market's own rise (timing)

decided_by: Slope positive with t >= 2 and the timing part of the book's gain is above 0.
reading: Each coin's mean 7-bar return is the mean of its non-overlapping grid returns over all windows; the book's gain before costs is the held allocation times the next close-to-close return, averaged over coins per day, and its market part uses each coin's mean daily return over all windows.
